plan: Keep print_original trivial: return authored_text unchanged so originals stay byte-for-byte printable regardless of adaptations.

Resolve each ingredient through a substitution chain: while its name is excluded, pick the catalog choice with lowest (priority, catalog index), apply quantity_factor/unit/preparation, and record the choice id; a per-chain seen-set detects cycles, a missing choice records 'no substitution for NAME'. Failures record reasons but never abort, so all independent reasons are gathered.

Accumulate substitution side effects in a ledger: wording-change pairs, equipment additions/removals, yield factors, and additional ingredients; additional ingredients re-enter the same work queue so they are subject to exclusions and chained substitutions.
Compute needed equipment as (recipe equipment plus additions minus removals, plus component equipment minus removals) and record 'equipment NAME unavailable' for anything outside available_equipment.

If any reasons exist, return {possible: False, recipe: None, choices considered, sorted warnings, sorted reasons}; otherwise apply one global Fraction scale (target_yield/recipe yield divided by the product of substitution yield factors) to every quantity, rewrite instruction strings with the collected wording changes, sort equipment, regenerate an authored_text rendering, and return the adapted recipe with ordered choice ids and sorted warnings.
Build only fresh dicts/lists throughout so neither function mutates its inputs; verify with a deepcopy snapshot in the self-test.

Include a __main__ acceptance suite covering: 3->5 scaling, chained substitution (cream -> coconut cream -> oat cream), a substitution changing a referenced verb and removing equipment, a reintroduced exclusion with no further substitution, multiple simultaneous impossibility reasons, exact original print plus non-mutation, explicit-priority and catalog-order determinism, a substitution cycle, and chained additional-ingredient substitution.
mechanisms: substitution chain resolver with per-chain seen-set cycle detection
deterministic choice selection by (priority, catalog index)
effects ledger accumulating wording changes, equipment deltas, yield factors, and additional ingredients
work-queue processing so additional ingredients undergo the same exclusion and substitution pipeline
exhaustive reason collection (per-ingredient and equipment) before declaring impossibility
single global Fraction scale factor applied after resolution to hit the exact target yield
pure construction of fresh output structures guaranteeing input immutability
authored_text passthrough for byte-exact original printing
